{{Quote|This is my first day on Dxun. My predecessor displeased our masters, and was dealt with. The fool let Cannoks through the perimeter. The Sith don't tolerate any failure. I'm the fifth captain to command this base camp. The camp sits in the shadow of a tomb. My subordinates say that the body of an ancient warlord called Freedon Nadd lies inside. We don't know why we're here. We sit and ensure that no beasts make it into our camp, and, especially that they don't reach the tomb itself. A bleak assignment. Signing off.|Sith captain|<ref name="KotOR II game" />}}
A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] '''captain''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Sith Civil War]]. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was posted on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], and was the fifth officer to hold the post after his predecessors were killed either by the beasts of Dxun or their Sith superiors.

==Biography==
===Career===
{{Quote|This jungle feels similar to Korriban, before it fell after the war. Everyone is on edge. Executions and infractions are common place here, fifty percent more than my previous command.|Sith captain|<ref name="KotOR II game" />}}
A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was originally stationed on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and was eventually placed in command of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He survived the [[Sith Civil War]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] bombardment of the planet that followed. After the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] split into various factions, the captain sided with the [[Sith Triumvirate]].<ref name="KotOR II game" />

After the former [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]] was executed by a Sith for failure, the Sith captain replaced him, though he took no joy in the posting. He was constantly plagued by the beasts of Dxun, and the high mortality rates among his own men.<ref name="KotOR II game" />

Eventually the captain became concerned about the large military presence building up around the Dxun moons, and pressed his [[Unidentified Sith Master (Dxun)|Sith master]] for reinforcements. The Sith, however, simply replied that soon it wouldn't concern him. When asked for specifics, the Sith merely told him that it was a "surprise".<ref name="KotOR II game" />
